# 📋 Job Description & ATS Alignment Analysis: Flam

**Target Company:** Flam (Bengaluru, India)  
**Role Title:** Software Engineering Intern  
**Company Domain:** AI-Native Visual Content Platform, Real-Time Interactive 3D, Generative AI (Fable, Fantom, Falcon Models), Low-Latency Streaming (<300ms)  
**Application Type:** Internship  
**Analysis Date:** 2026-09-22  

---

## 1. Role Overview & Core Expectations

Flam is an AI-native content platform taking the internet beyond video by streaming life-like immersive visuals and fluid 3D interactions applessly in under 300ms for Fortune 500 brands. The engineering team sits at the intersection of generative AI, real-time rendering, and enterprise-grade web architecture.

As a **Software Engineering Intern**, expectations include:
- **Modular Frontend Architecture:** Architect, develop, and maintain scalable and modular web frontends using **React and Next.js**, building reusable component libraries.
- **Interactive 3D & Graphics Rendering:** Design and develop interactive 3D experiences leveraging **Three.js, WebGL, and the Canvas API**.
- **API Integration & Performance:** Integrate APIs, optimize client-side rendering and streaming performance, and troubleshoot across diverse browser environments.
- **Software Craftsmanship & Best Practices:** Write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and employ modern version control (Git/GitHub).
- **Emerging Tech & Generative AI:** Research emerging technologies, collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and backend/AI teams to bring product requirements to life.

## 4. Qualitative Match Assessment

* **Overall Alignment:** **~85% Alignment (High-Fit Candidate)**
* **Key Competitive Advantages:**
  1. **Dual Strength in Frontend & GenAI:** Most frontend applicants lack systems-level GenAI/RAG understanding; most AI applicants lack polished React/WebGL skills. Rithish bridges both seamlessly with Plantera and PatentIQ.
  2. **WebGL & Canvas Familiarity:** Plantera proves practical production experience with hardware-accelerated WebGL rendering layers and interactive canvas visualizations.
  3. **Open Source Code Quality:** ESLint Core PR #21218 proves meticulous attention to JavaScript engine internals, language specifications, and clean PR workflows.
  4. **High Execution Speed:** Multiple 1st place hackathon victories demonstrate an ability to build fast and ship cleanly in fast-moving startup environments like Flam.
* **Gaps & Interview Preparation:**
  - Flam focuses on real-time rendering (<300ms streaming) and Three.js 3D pipelines. In interviews, be prepared to discuss WebGL shaders (vertex/fragment), scene graphs, draw calls, frame budgeting (60fps / 16.6ms), and asset streaming optimization.
